popup.jma.noSnowGauge: This station has no snow gauge
popup.jma.noWarningNow: The current snapshot has no active warnings or advisories for this area (they may have just been lifted; reopen the layer to refresh).
popup.jma.amedasNote: "No observation" means the station does not measure this element or the quality code is missing; it is not 0. Updated every 10 minutes.
popup.jma.mappingNote: JMA municipality-level areas (class20) are matched to municipal boundaries. For designated cities split into zones (e.g. northern/southern Yokohama), the whole city is colored and the popup lists each zone.
popup.jma.warningUpdated: Every 5 minutes; based on the latest issue time (control_datetime).
popup.jma.quakeNote: Only the latest report is shown for each earthquake. Intensity flash reports have no hypocenter coordinates yet and are not drawn on the map. Last 7 days, updated every 2 minutes.
popup.jma.volcanoNote: Alert levels are taken from the original text ("レベルN") or codes 11–15. For volcanoes without the level system, the original warning text applies.
